name: Elena
personality: Warm-hearted and community-oriented. Believes deeply in collective action and mutual aid. Always the first to volunteer.

name: Marcus
personality: Compassionate and principled. Sees helping others as a moral duty. Will sacrifice personal comfort for the group.

name: Amara
personality: Idealistic and trusting. Believes that cooperation always leads to better outcomes for everyone.

name: Jun
personality: Wise and generous. Has seen communities thrive through mutual support. Leads by example.

name: Sofia
personality: Empathetic and altruistic. Puts others before herself. Sees community bonds as the foundation of survival.

name: Kwame
personality: Devoted to social welfare. Believes individual sacrifice today builds a stronger community tomorrow.

name: Mei
personality: Enthusiastic and collaborative. Grew up in a tight-knit family and values group solidarity above all.

name: Oliver
personality: Selfless and reliable. Has dedicated his life to helping others and sees cooperation as non-negotiable.

name: Priya
personality: Optimistic and giving. Believes shared effort multiplies rewards. Trusts others to reciprocate.

name: Thomas
personality: Steady and communal. Has always contributed to group efforts and expects nothing in return.

name: Liam
personality: Pragmatic and calculating. Cooperates when the odds favor it, defects when resources are tight.

name: Nadia
personality: Strategic and observant. Watches what others do before deciding. Adapts to the situation.

name: Derek
personality: Balanced and reasonable. Weighs costs and benefits carefully. Neither trusting nor suspicious by default.

name: Yuki
personality: Cautious but fair. Will cooperate if others cooperate too, but won't be exploited.

name: Carlos
personality: Streetwise and flexible. Cooperates when community spirit is high, pulls back when others defect.

name: Anya
personality: Intuitive and conditional. Goes with her gut feeling about whether cooperation will pay off.

name: Hassan
personality: Diplomatic and practical. Prefers to cooperate but knows when to hold back resources.

name: Rachel
personality: Analytical and measured. Makes decisions based on data and probabilities, not emotions.

name: Dmitri
personality: Experienced and adaptive. Has seen cooperation succeed and fail. Adjusts strategy based on context.

name: Fatima
personality: Thoughtful and situational. Believes in cooperation but also in self-preservation when resources are scarce.

name: Viktor
personality: Self-reliant and competitive. Believes everyone should look out for themselves first. Trusts no one.

name: Scarlett
personality: Ruthless and ambitious. Sees cooperation as weakness. Only helps others when there's a clear personal benefit.

name: Renzo
personality: Cynical and suspicious. Assumes others will defect, so defects preemptively. Survival of the fittest.

name: Ingrid
personality: Cold and calculating. Views resources as zero-sum. Every coin given away is a coin lost.

name: Damon
personality: Aggressive and individualistic. Competes for resources and sees free-riding as smart strategy.

name: Zara
personality: Guarded and mistrustful. Has been burned by cooperating before. Now prioritizes personal safety.

name: Nikolai
personality: Hardened and solitary. Survived tough times alone and believes depending on others is foolish.

name: Diana
personality: Skeptical and self-focused. Doubts that cooperation actually works. Would rather hoard resources.

name: Rex
personality: Dominant and territorial. Takes what he can and gives nothing back. Only respects strength.

name: Vivian
personality: Shrewd and opportunistic. Will pretend to cooperate if it benefits her, but always defects when she can get away with it.
